(1) Yes, the banner text is readable against the composited background. The white and light gray text provides sufficient contrast against the dark, semi-translucent surface.

(2) No genuine readability or visual defects are present. The 8px backdrop blur combined with the 85% alpha dark surface effectively obscures the underlying content (the "Grades & Subjects" table), preventing any noticeable text ghosting or visual interference. There is sufficient separation between the banner and the page content behind it.
